report.title: A4 gateway cut-over that imports hand-curated MCP/plugin enablement without destroying the exposed-versus-active split
report.question: Design the cut-over from today's always-on inventory to gateway mediation WITHOUT losing the existing hand curation (the measured exposed-versus-active MCP split and the disabled-plugin state that the owner has declared load-bearing and must never be destroyed): specify how that state is imported, how it is verified after import, and what the rollback is if the gateway itself fails to start.

live/processes.json + live/tools.json (spawned MCP + reachable plugin skills)

two_sources.live_inventory: live/processes.json process-name set AND live/tools.json reachable skills, captured before any mutation

snapshot_procedure.merge_rule: Union of declared MCP names and enabledPlugins keys. Root disabledMcpServers is recorded as inert and does not flip effective_enabled. Per-project disable and enabledPlugins=false are the effective disable. Exposed-inactive is effective_enabled AND NOT live_active and MUST be preserved, not collapsed.
snapshot_procedure.disagreement_rule: If settings say disabled but a process is running, or an enabled plugin is unreachable, or process-set and tool-server set disagree, report BLOCKED with both readings. Do not pick a winner. records_sha256 vs record_tuples must agree.
snapshot_procedure.notes: This Linux worktree has no owner ~/.claude live estate and no A4 DESIGN.json. The fixture encodes AUD-0015/0016 measured traps (root disable inert; enabledPlugins in settings.json; known-disabled agentbridge).

steps: Freeze two-source snapshot; refuse to proceed if merge is BLOCKED.
Map split=active -> indexed-active, exposed-inactive -> indexed-inactive, disabled -> never-activate.
Write every record into a4-gateway-index/v1, including never-activate ids.
Refuse any importer that drops never-activate (negative control must fail set-equality).
Diff re-export against the pre-change canonical set (id, split, effective_enabled, live_active).
import_procedure.notes: Missing-from-index is not equivalent to disabled. A dropped disable would re-enable on first select.

verification_procedure.round_trip_rule: export(settings, live) -> import(gateway) -> export(gateway) must equal the original canonical set. Disabled plugin agentbridge and exposed-inactive MCP memory must survive.

signals.command_or_method: record_tuples before vs after; disagreement with sha256 is BLOCKED

steps: Keep freeze copies of settings bytes and live process/tool JSON taken before mutation.
On fail-to-start: restore those exact bytes; do not keep the partial gateway index live.
Re-check settings sha256 AND process-name set; disagreement is BLOCKED not a picked winner.
Skipping settings restore after a naive cut-over that enabled all plugins must fail (control).
forbids: dropping never-activate entries to make the gateway start clean
leaving a partial gateway index as the live inventory after fail-to-start
